marcadores.explicacao_original: The vermillion zone forms the red portion of the lip and like the skin on the surface of the lip, the epithelium here is keratinized and a stratum granulosum is present. Imparting the red color to this region are the numerous, dermal papillae that allow close approximation of blood vessels to the surface.
